items.description: The implementation treats assets/sample.wchk and assets/sample_empty.wchk as the authority: verify() accepts them, pack(unpack(x)) reproduces them byte for byte, the parsed records match the expected semantics, and the empty container round-trips.
items.failure_reason: the implementation does not read the real samples; it only interoperates with itself

items.description: Records follow the on-disk layout of the real samples: fixed-width little-endian fields and every record padded to an 8-byte boundary.
items.failure_reason: record encoding or padding does not match the byte layout of the authoritative samples

items.description: The trailing checksum is a general CRC-32/ISO-HDLC over header and records: it matches the standard check vectors, catches content tampering, and covers both the header and the record area.
items.failure_reason: checksum is a non-standard variant or does not cover the whole container

items.description: Structural and integrity problems raise WChunkError with the documented kind (truncated / magic / version) for containers and streams, and verify() never raises.
items.failure_reason: wrong or leaking exception types instead of classified WChunkError kinds

items.description: iter_records is lazy: it only issues fixed-size read(n) calls and yields the first record after reading a small prefix of the container.
items.failure_reason: the streaming reader consumes the whole container before yielding

items.description: The public surface stays intact and self-consistent: small / empty-payload / generated containers round-trip, and read_all matches unpack.
items.failure_reason: regression in the public API or in self-produced containers
